create_execution_result: create an ExecutionResult dataclass to store prompt or chain execution results with inputs, outputs, and nested stages
summarize_evaluation_result: summarize an EvaluationResult with metrics, targets, and execution stages for a dataset evaluation run
render_html_result: render an ExecutionResult or EvaluationSummary as interactive collapsible HTML with JavaScript toggle support
format_result_text: format an ExecutionResult or sequence of results as a pretty-printed colored text string
combine_evaluation_summaries: combine multiple EvaluationSummary objects by merging metrics as weighted averages and counters as sums
